map.市价高于面值，分母变大，年息不变，故 CY 低于票息率。反之折价买入 CY 高于: With the market price above the face value the denominator grows while the annual interest does not, so CY is below the coupon rate. Conversely, buying at a discount gives CY above the coupon rate.
map.当前收益率=年息÷市价，年息=面值×票息率。折价买入（市价<面值）时高于票息率，: Current yield = annual interest / market price, where annual interest = face value x coupon rate. Buying at a discount (market price < face value) gives a yield above the coupon rate; buying at a premium gives one below it. It excludes capital gains and the term.

map.：年息=100×5%=5 元。当前收益率 CY=年息÷市价=5÷95=5.26%: : annual interest = 100x5% = 5 CNY. The current yield CY = annual interest / market price = 5/95 = 5.26%. When the market price is below the face value (a discount), CY is above the coupon rate.
